title: Breviarium

info.psalm_quote: Seven times a day I praise you for your upright judgements.
info.quote_sc: And the laity, too, are encouraged to recite the divine office, either with the priests, or among themselves, or even individually.
info.quote_cec: The Liturgy of the Hours is intended to become the prayer of the whole People of God.
info.title: What is the Liturgy of the Hours?
info.what: It is the official prayer of the Church. Through psalms, canticles, Scripture readings and intercessions, it consecrates the hours of the day to God and unites whoever prays it with the whole Church, praying the same words all over the world. Although priests and religious pray it as an obligation, the Church invites all the faithful to make it their own.
info.hours: Its two hinges are Lauds, in the morning, and Vespers, in the evening. Through the day come Terce, Sext and None; Compline, before sleep; and the Office of Readings, at any time.
info.why_complete: Every day you get the full text following the liturgical calendar, with no page-flipping or switching books.
info.why_hour: It suggests the hour that fits the time of day, so all you have to do is start praying.
info.why_offline: It works offline, and it's free and open source.

hints.laudes_and_evangelium: Adds the Gospel of the day to Lauds, after the responsory.
hints.laudes_and_office: Adds the Office of Readings to Lauds, after the responsory.
hints.vesperae_and_office: Adds the Office of Readings to Vespers, after the responsory.
hints.hide_invitatorium: Lauds starts without the invitatory psalm.
hints.bienal_office_by_default: The Office of Readings shows the two-year cycle readings first.
hints.prefer_latin_prayers: Prayers that have a Latin version are shown in Latin by default (Our Father, Angelus, Benedictus, Magnificat, Nunc dimittis, Regina Caeli and Marian antiphons).
hints.office_deceased: Adds an entry on the home screen to pray the Office of the Dead.
hints.show_cross_references: Shows the column of parallel passages next to each verse.
hints.show_auto_scroll: Shows a button that scrolls prayer text automatically.
hints.keepAwake: The screen stays on while you use the app.
hints.haptics_active: Vibrates when you tap buttons and navigate.
hints.show_text_to_speech: Reads the whole prayer with the device voice, with controls to pause, skip sentences and change the speed.
hints.tts_voice: Spanish voices installed on the device.
hints.tts_install: Opens the system settings to download voices if there is no Spanish one.
hints.tts_unsupported: Reading aloud is not available on this device.
hints.tts_floating_button: If you hide it, you can start reading from the headphones icon at the top of the prayer.

about.title: About Breviarium
about.what_text: Breviarium is a free, open-source app for praying the Liturgy of the Hours every day. It also includes the complete Bible and the saints of the Roman Martyrology.
about.mission_text: Breviarium's mission is to help you cultivate your spiritual life, joining your prayer to that of the whole Church, which prays the same hours all over the world.
